@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The model hadn't had a proper meal for days, so she f______ted from hunger.
= fainted
~詞義 faint（v.）昏倒
~原文 The model hadn't had a proper meal for days, so she fainted from hunger.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Susan is a very kind person. She is always e______r to help those in need.
= eager
~詞義 eager（adj.）熱切的
~原文 Susan is a very kind person. She is always eager to help those in need.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Since he was sixteen, Nick has been saving money to realize his dream of studying a______d.
= abroad
~詞義 abroad（adv.）在國外
~原文 Since he was sixteen, Nick has been saving money to realize his dream of studying abroad.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: For some aboriginal groups in Taiwan, facial tattoos are a t______l tradition.
= tribal
~詞義 tribal（adj.）部落的
~原文 For some aboriginal groups in Taiwan, facial tattoos are a tribal tradition.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: At the end of the lecture, the professor briefly s______ed his main points in a few words.
= summarized
~詞義 summarize（v.）總結;概括地說
~原文 At the end of the lecture, the professor briefly summarized his main points in a few words.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: I am allergic to ______ products, so I cannot eat yogurt, cream, or any kind of cheese.
A: angle
B: bacon
C: cabin
D: dairy
= D
~詞義 dairy（adj.）乳製品
~原文 I am allergic to dairy products, so I cannot eat yogurt, cream, or any kind of cheese.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Many people want to buy ______ computers because they are light and convenient to use.
A: shadow
B: gallon
C: canyon
D: tablet
= D
~詞義 tablet（n.）平板
~原文 Many people want to buy tablet computers because they are light and convenient to use.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: On her way to the airport, Louise suddenly realized that she had left her ______ at the hotel and had to head back there.
A: angel
B: baggage
C: gallon
D: tunnel
= B
~詞義 baggage（n.）行李
~原文 On her way to the airport, Louise suddenly realized that she had left her baggage at the hotel and had to head back there.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Ellen's friendships with other students gradually ______ as the days went by.
A: widened
B: apologized
C: survived
D: deepened
= D
~詞義 deepen（v.）加深
~原文 Ellen's friendships with other students gradually deepened as the days went by.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Tom was so ______ that he spilled his drink three times during dinner and broke a glass.
A: awkward
B: clumsy
C: sexual
D: urban
= B
~詞義 clumsy（adj.）笨拙的
~原文 Tom was so clumsy that he spilled his drink three times during dinner and broke a glass.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: aboard
B: scarcely
C: satisfactory
D: apology
E: badly
F: sum

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The company has hired a team of experts to analyze the problem, but they haven't found a(n) ______ solution.
= C
~詞義 satisfactory（adj.）滿意的
~原文 The company has hired a team of experts to analyze the problem, but they haven't found a(n) satisfactory solution.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: She felt very sad because she had lost a large ______ of money.
= F
~詞義 sum（n.）總數
~原文 She felt very sad because she had lost a large sum of money.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: I was late to the party, and when I finally arrived, there was ______ any food left.
= B
~詞義 scarcely（adv.）幾乎不
~原文 I was late to the party, and when I finally arrived, there was scarcely any food left.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Everyone ______ the ship was in a panic when they heard that it was sinking.
= A
~詞義 aboard（prep.）在船上
~原文 Everyone aboard the ship was in a panic when they heard that it was sinking.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Please accept my sincere ______. I did not mean to hurt your feelings.
= D
~詞義 apology（n.）道歉
~原文 Please accept my sincere apology. I did not mean to hurt your feelings.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: angel
B: bleed
C: survivor
D: dash
E: cabin
F: lengthen

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Toward evening, the shadows ______ across the fields.
= F
~詞義 lengthen（v.）拉長
~原文 Toward evening, the shadows lengthen across the fields.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: I accidentally cut myself when I was using a knife, but the wound was small and didn't ______ much.
= B
~詞義 bleed（v.）流血
~原文 I accidentally cut myself when I was using a knife, but the wound was small and didn't bleed much.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: You can put a star or a(n) ______ on top of the Christmas tree.
= A
~詞義 angel（n.）天使
~原文 You can put a star or a(n) angel on top of the Christmas tree.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The lawyer spent his vacation relaxing in a quiet wooden ______ in the mountains, far away from the busy city life.
= E
~詞義 cabin（n.）小屋
~原文 The lawyer spent his vacation relaxing in a quiet wooden cabin in the mountains, far away from the busy city life.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The little boy is the only ______ of the horrible traffic accident.
= C
~詞義 survivor（n.）生還者
~原文 The little boy is the only survivor of the horrible traffic accident.
